3️⃣ Núcleo do Sistema

🔷 GraphEngine (Estado Reativo)

ts
export interface HoloNode {
  id: string
  label: string
  x?: number
  y?: number
  meta?: Record<string, any>
}

export interface HoloEdge {
  from: string
  to: string
  weight?: number
}

export class GraphEngine {
  nodes = new Map<string, HoloNode>()
  edges: HoloEdge[] = []

  addNode(node: HoloNode) {
    this.nodes.set(node.id, node)
  }

  addEdge(edge: HoloEdge) {
    this.edges.push(edge)
  }

  getGraph() {
    return {
      nodes: Array.from(this.nodes.values()),
      edges: this.edges
    }
  }
}

Esse núcleo é independente de Vue.

4️⃣ Integração com DOT + Graphviz

Usuário pode passar:

dot
digraph SmartDisplay {
  Core -> Engine
  Engine -> Renderer
  Renderer -> UI
}

Parser:

ts
import { graphlib, read } from 'graphlib-dot'

export function parseDot(dotString: string) {
  const g = read(dotString)

  return {
    nodes: g.nodes().map(id => ({
      id,
      label: id
    })),
    edges: g.edges().map(e => ({
      from: e.v,
      to: e.w
    }))
  }
}

Opcional:
usar Graphviz WASM para layout automático (hierárquico ou radial).

5️⃣ Layout Engine (D3 Force + Radial)

ts
import * as d3 from 'd3'

export function applyForceLayout(graph) {
  const simulation = d3.forceSimulation(graph.nodes)
    .force('link', d3.forceLink(graph.edges)
      .id((d: any) => d.id)
      .distance(150))
    .force('charge', d3.forceManyBody().strength(-400))
    .force('center', d3.forceCenter(500, 300))

  return simulation
}

Pode alternar entre:

  • force layout

  • radial

  • hierarchical (Graphviz)

  • orbital futurista

9️⃣ Animações Futuristas

Pulse effect:

ts
function pulse(nodeElement) {
  d3.select(nodeElement)
    .transition()
    .duration(800)
    .attr("r", 20)
    .transition()
    .duration(800)
    .attr("r", 15)
}

  stroke-dasharray: 5 5;
  animation: flow 2s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes flow {
  from { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
  to { stroke-dashoffset: 20; }
}

import * as d3 from 'd3'

export function render(container: HTMLElement, graph: any) {
  const width = container.clientWidth
  const height = container.clientHeight

  const svg = d3.select(container)
    .append("svg")
    .attr("width", width)
    .attr("height", height)
    .style("background", "radial-gradient(circle, #001219, #000814)")
    .style("mix-blend-mode", "screen")

  const link = svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("line")
    .data(graph.edges)
    .enter()
    .append("line")
    .attr("stroke", "cyan")
    .attr("stroke-opacity", 0.4)

  const node = svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("circle")
    .data(graph.nodes)
    .enter()
    .append("circle")
    .attr("r", 12)
    .attr("fill", "rgba(0,255,255,0.2)")
    .attr("stroke", "cyan")
    .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
    .call(d3.drag()
      .on("drag", (event: any, d: any) => {
        d.x = event.x
        d.y = event.y
      })
    )

  return { svg, link, node }
}
EOF

cat << 'EOF' > src/core/EventBus.ts
type Listener = (payload?: any) => void

export class EventBus {
  private listeners = new Map<string, Listener[]>()

  on(event: string, fn: Listener) {
    if (!this.listeners.has(event)) {
      this.listeners.set(event, [])
    }
    this.listeners.get(event)?.push(fn)
  }

  emit(event: string, payload?: any) {
    this.listeners.get(event)?.forEach(fn => fn(payload))
  }
}
EOF

export function adaptDatabaseSchema(schema: any) {
  const nodes = []
  const edges = []

  for (const table of schema.tables) {
    nodes.push({
      id: table.name,
      type: "table",
      meta: table
    })

    for (const relation of table.relations || []) {
      edges.push({
        from: table.name,
        to: relation.target,
        label: relation.type
      })
    }
  }

  return { nodes, edges }
}
EOF

self.onmessage = function(event: any) {
  const graph = event.data
  const updated = graph.nodes.map((n: any, i: number) => ({
    ...n,
    x: Math.cos(i) * 300,

  }))
  self.postMessage(updated)
}

cat << 'EOF' > src/render/CanvasRenderer.ts
export function createCanvasRenderer(container: HTMLElement) {
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas")
  container.appendChild(canvas)
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d")

  function draw(nodes: any[], edges: any[]) {
    if (!ctx) return
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height)

    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,255,255,0.4)"
    edges.forEach(e => {
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(e.source.x, e.source.y)
      ctx.lineTo(e.target.x, e.target.y)
      ctx.stroke()
    })

    nodes.forEach(n => {
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.arc(n.x, n.y, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2)
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,255,255,0.3)"
      ctx.fill()
    })
  }

  return { draw }
}
EOF

export function calculateDegreeCentrality(graph: any) {
  const centrality: any = {}

  graph.edges.forEach((e: any) => {
    centrality[e.from] = (centrality[e.from] || 0) + 1
    centrality[e.to] = (centrality[e.to] || 0) + 1
  })

  return centrality
}
EOF

cat << 'EOF' > src/cinematic/GridLayer.ts
export function createGrid(container: HTMLElement) {
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas")
  container.appendChild(canvas)
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d")!

  canvas.width = window.innerWidth
  canvas.height = window.innerHeight

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height)
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,255,255,0.05)"

    for(let i=0;i<canvas.width;i+=40){
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(i,0)
      ctx.lineTo(i,canvas.height)
      ctx.stroke()
    }

    for(let j=0;j<canvas.height;j+=40){
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(0,j)
      ctx.lineTo(canvas.width,j)
      ctx.stroke()
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(draw)
  }

  draw()
}
EOF

# -------------------------
# PARTICLES WEBGL
# -------------------------
cat << 'EOF' > src/cinematic/ParticleLayer.ts
import * as THREE from 'three'

export function createParticles(container: HTMLElement) {

  const scene = new THREE.Scene()
  const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000)
  const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ alpha: true })
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight)
  container.appendChild(renderer.domElement)

  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
  const vertices = []

  for (let i = 0; i < 2000; i++) {
    vertices.push(
      THREE.MathUtils.randFloatSpread(2000),
      THREE.MathUtils.randFloatSpread(2000),
      THREE.MathUtils.randFloatSpread(2000)
    )
  }

  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(vertices, 3))
  const material = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color: 0x00ffff, size: 2 })
  const particles = new THREE.Points(geometry, material)
  scene.add(particles)

  camera.position.z = 500

  function animate() {
    requestAnimationFrame(animate)
    particles.rotation.y += 0.0005
    renderer.render(scene, camera)
  }

  animate()
}
EOF

# -------------------------
# PARALLAX ENGINE

cat << 'EOF' > src/cinematic/ParallaxEngine.ts
export function enableParallax(container: HTMLElement) {
  container.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
    const x = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth - 0.5) * 20
    const y = (e.clientY / window.innerHeight - 0.5) * 20
    container.style.transform = `rotateX(${y}deg) rotateY(${x}deg)`
  })
}
EOF

# SCANLINE EFFECT

export function applyScanline(container: HTMLElement) {
  const overlay = document.createElement("div")
  overlay.style.position = "absolute"
  overlay.style.top = "0"
  overlay.style.left = "0"
  overlay.style.width = "100%"
  overlay.style.height = "100%"
  overlay.style.pointerEvents = "none"
  overlay.style.background = "repeating-linear-gradient(rgba(0,255,255,0.03) 0px, rgba(0,255,255,0.03) 1px, transparent 2px, transparent 4px)"
  container.appendChild(overlay)
}
EOF

bash
#!/bin/bash

echo "🚀 Creating HoloGraph Enterprise Global Platform..."

ROOT="holograph-platform"
mkdir $ROOT
cd $ROOT

mkdir -p apps/{web,api,worker,ai-service}
mkdir -p packages/{engine-core,cinematic-ui,er-engine,analytics-engine,auth-core,shared}
mkdir -p database/prisma
mkdir -p infra/{nginx,k8s}
mkdir scripts

# ==============================
# ROOT PACKAGE
# ==============================
cat << 'EOF' > package.json
{
  "name": "holograph-platform",
  "private": true,
  "workspaces": ["apps/*", "packages/*"],
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "concurrently \"npm run dev --workspace=apps/api\" \"npm run dev --workspace=apps/web\"",
    "build": "npm run build --workspaces"
  }
}
EOF

# ==============================
# ENV FILE
# ==============================
cat << 'EOF' > .env.example
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://holo:holo@postgres:5432/holograph
JWT_SECRET=supersecret
REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
EOF

# ==============================
# DOCKER COMPOSE
# ==============================
cat << 'EOF' > docker-compose.yml
version: "3.9"

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:15
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: holo
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: holo
      POSTGRES_DB: holograph
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"

  redis:
    image: redis:7
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"

  api:
    build: ./apps/api
    env_file: .env
    ports:
      - "4000:4000"
    depends_on:
      - postgres
      - redis

  worker:
    build: ./apps/worker
    env_file: .env
    depends_on:
      - redis
      - postgres

  web:
    build: ./apps/web
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    depends_on:
      - api

volumes:
  pgdata:
EOF

# ==============================
# PRISMA SCHEMA (MULTI TENANT)
# ==============================
cat << 'EOF' > database/prisma/schema.prisma
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model Tenant {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  name      String
  users     User[]
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

model User {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  email     String   @unique
  password  String
  role      Role
  tenantId  String
  tenant    Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id])
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

model DatabaseConnection {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId  String
  type      String
  host      String
  port      Int
  database  String
  username  String
  password  String
}

enum Role {
  ADMIN
  ANALYST
  VIEWER
}
EOF

cat << 'EOF' > apps/api/server.js
import Fastify from 'fastify'
import jwt from '@fastify/jwt'
import cors from '@fastify/cors'

const app = Fastify()

app.register(cors)
app.register(jwt, { secret: process.env.JWT_SECRET })

app.decorate("authenticate", async function(request, reply) {
  try {
    await request.jwtVerify()
  } catch (err) {
    reply.send(err)
  }
})

app.get('/health', async () => ({ status: 'ok' }))

app.listen({ port: 4000 })
EOF

async function loadPlaylist() {
    const response = await fetch('/api/playlist/current');
    const data = await response.json();

    const videoPlayer = document.getElementById("smartPlayer");
    videoPlayer.src = data.currentVideoUrl;
}

async function switchTenantPlaylist(tenantId) {
    await fetch(`/api/playlist/switch`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ tenantId })
    });

    loadPlaylist();
}

🌌 particles.js (efeito holográfico)

javascript
const canvas = document.getElementById('bgCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
canvas.height = window.innerHeight;

let particles = [];

for (let i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
    particles.push({
        x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
        y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
        r: Math.random() * 2,
        d: Math.random() * 1
    });
}

function drawParticles() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#00f0ff";
    particles.forEach(p => {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        p.y += p.d;
        if (p.y > canvas.height) p.y = 0;
    });
    requestAnimationFrame(drawParticles);
}

drawParticles();

tsx
// Scene.tsx
import { Canvas } from "@react-three/fiber"
import { useRef } from "react"
import * as THREE from "three"

function Grid() {
  const mesh = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null!)

  return (
    <mesh ref={mesh} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
      <planeGeometry args={[200, 200, 50, 50]} />
      <meshBasicMaterial wireframe color="#00f0ff" />
    </mesh>
  )
}

export default function Scene() {
  return (
    <Canvas camera={{ position: [0, 20, 40] }}>
      <ambientLight intensity={0.5} />
      <Grid />
    </Canvas>
  )
}

🎥 SmartSignage Player integrado

tsx
// SmartPlayer.tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react"

export default function SmartPlayer({ tenantId }) {
  const [video, setVideo] = useState("")

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch(`/api/${tenantId}/playlist/current`)
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(data => setVideo(data.url))
  }, [tenantId])

  return (
    <video
      src={video}
      autoPlay
      muted
      loop
      style={{
        position: "absolute",
        right: 20,
        bottom: 20,
        width: 400,
        border: "2px solid cyan",
        boxShadow: "0 0 20px cyan"
      }}
    />
  )
}

🎯 Exemplo – Layout Generator

ts
@Injectable()
export class LayoutGeneratorService {

  generateLayout(context: any) {

    if (context.time === "morning") {
      return {
        theme: "light-retail",
        videoSize: "medium",
        highlightZone: "top-right"
      }
    }

    if (context.engagement < 40) {
      return {
        theme: "high-contrast-neon",
        videoSize: "large",
        highlightZone: "center"
      }
    }

    return {
      theme: "corporate-dark",
      videoSize: "balanced"
    }
  }
}

import cv2
import mediapipe as mp

cap = cv2.VideoCapture(0)

    results = mp_face.process(frame)

    people_count = 0
    if results.detections:
        people_count = len(results.detections)

    print("People detected:", people_count)

Fluxo RTB

markdown

Motor calcula:
   Score = Bid + Relevância + Performance

Campanha vencedora é exibida

Pseudocódigo

ts
const winner = campaigns
  .map(c => ({
     ...c,
     score: c.bid + relevance(c, context) + performance(c)
  }))
  .sort((a,b) => b.score - a.score)[0]

display(winner)

📄 server.ts

ts
import Fastify from "fastify"
import websocket from "@fastify/websocket"

const app = Fastify()
app.register(websocket)

let currentContext = null

app.post("/context", async (req, reply) => {
  currentContext = req.body
  broadcastContext(currentContext)
  return { ok: true }
})

const clients = []

app.get("/ws", { websocket: true }, (connection) => {
  clients.push(connection)

  connection.socket.on("close", () => {
    const index = clients.indexOf(connection)
    clients.splice(index, 1)
  })
})

function broadcastContext(context) {
  clients.forEach(client => {
    client.socket.send(JSON.stringify(context))
  })
}

app.listen({ port: 4000, host: "0.0.0.0" })

Backend mínimo funcional.

export function useContextEngine() {

📄 App.tsx

tsx
import { useContextEngine } from "./hooks/useContextEngine"
import { motion } from "framer-motion"

function selectLayout(context) {
  if (!context) return "idle"
  if (context.people === 1 && context.attention > 0.7)
    return "premium"
  if (context.people > 3)
    return "impact"
  return "default"
}

export default function App() {
  const context = useContextEngine()
  const layout = selectLayout(context)

  return (
    <motion.div
      key={layout}
      initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
      className="fullscreen"
    >
      <Layout mode={layout} />
    </motion.div>
  )
}

📄 vision.py (detecção real simplificada)

python
import cv2
import mediapipe as mp
import requests
import time

mp_face = mp.solutions.face_detection
face_detection = mp_face.FaceDetection()

cap = cv2.VideoCapture(0)

while True:
    ret, frame = cap.read()
    if not ret:
        continue

    rgb = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
    results = face_detection.process(rgb)

    people = 0
    if results.detections:
        people = len(results.detections)

    payload = {
        "people": people,
        "attention": 0.8 if people > 0 else 0.0,
        "movement": "moderate"
    }

    requests.post("http://backend:4000/context", json=payload)

    time.sleep(2)

💰 FASE 2 — RTB FÍSICO BÁSICO

Agora vamos tornar isso inteligente.

Estrutura de campanha

No backend:

ts
type Campaign = {
  id: string
  name: string
  baseBid: number
  minPeople?: number
}

Exemplo de campanhas

ts
const campaigns = [
  { id: "1", name: "Premium Watch", baseBid: 10, minPeople: 1 },
  { id: "2", name: "Family Pizza", baseBid: 15, minPeople: 3 }
]

Engine simples de leilão

ts
function selectCampaign(context) {
  let winner = null
  let highestScore = 0

  campaigns.forEach(c => {
    if (context.people >= (c.minPeople || 0)) {
      const score = c.baseBid * context.attention

      if (score > highestScore) {
        highestScore = score
        winner = c
      }
    }
  })

  return winner
}
